boxes.label: How might we…
boxes.hint: Pick one thing that got in the way, and turn it into a question.

boxes.label: Ideas
boxes.hint: One idea per box. Then everyone puts three dots on the ideas they'd back.
boxes.reader: Copy each idea into `text` and count its dots into `votes` (a number; 0 if none). A dot drawn on the line between two boxes counts for the box it's mostly in; if you can't tell, record your reading and add it to `unclear`. Number ideas in reading order, by the printed number on each box.

slide.prompt: Turn one thing that got in the way into a question, then fill the boxes with ideas. Last two minutes: three dots each.
notes: The question works best when it's specific: “How might we stop releases slipping in the last week?”, not “How might we be better?”
Call time for dots with two minutes to go. Dots go on ideas, not on people.
